name: Exp_ColorZerolagDeMarker
summary: This EA trades based on crossovers of the ColorZerolagDeMarker custom indicator, which is a zero-lag smoothed DeMarker oscillator composed of five weighted DeMarker components. It opens buy positions when the main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable buy/sell open/close switches and standard stop-loss/take-profit management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorZerolagDeMarker自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标由五个加权DeMarker分量组成的零滞后平滑振荡器。当主线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，并提供可配置的买卖开平仓开关及标准止损止盈管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于零滞后DeMarker振荡器的交叉信号，该振荡器通过五个不同周期（8/21/34/55/89）的DeMarker指标加权组合（权重0.05/0.10/0.16/0.26/0.43）来消除滞后性。入场条件为：当缓冲区0（主线）上穿缓冲区1（信号线）时产生买入信号，下穿时产生卖出信号，且仅在上一根K线与当前K线交叉方向变化时触发。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向交叉信号触发平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制手数比例，支持固定手数和保证金比例两种模式。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms库的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen函数实现。策略采用新K线检测机制避免重复信号，并支持分别控制买卖方向的开仓和平仓权限。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on crossover signals from a zero-lag DeMarker oscillator, which combines five DeMarker indicators with different periods (8/21/34/55/89) and weighted factors (0.05/0.10/0.16/0.26/0.43) to eliminate lag. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when buffer 0 (main line) crosses above buffer 1 (signal line), and a sell signal on the opposite crossover, triggered only when the crossing direction changes between the previous and current bar. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points, as well as position closing on reverse crossover signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting both fixed lot size and margin-based ratio modes via the LOT/FREE MarginMode enumeration. Money management relies on the external TradeAlgorithms library's BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen functions. The strategy uses a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated signals and supports independently enabling/disabling buy/sell open and close operations.

pros: 零滞后设计通过多周期加权组合有效减少传统DeMarker指标的滞后性
提供买卖方向独立的开平仓控制开关，灵活性高
采用新K线检测机制，避免同一K线内重复触发信号
五层DeMarker使用斐波那契数列周期（8/21/34/55/89），符合技术分析经典理论
止损止盈参数可配置，具备基本风险控制框架
pros_en: Zero-lag design effectively reduces the lag of traditional DeMarker indicators through multi-period weighted combination
Independent buy/sell open/close control switches provide high flexibility
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated signal triggers within the same bar
Five DeMarker layers use Fibonacci sequence periods (8/21/34/55/89), aligning with classic technical analysis theory
Configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
cons: 依赖外部TradeAlgorithms库和自定义指标ColorZerolagDeMarker，缺少独立性和可移植性
没有检查是否已存在同方向持仓，可能导致重复开仓
缺少点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在不利条件下仍可能开仓
DeMarker_period4使用int类型而非uint，与其他周期参数类型不一致
没有追踪止损机制，止盈止损为固定点数，无法根据市场波动动态调整
cons_en: Depends on external TradeAlgorithms library and custom ColorZerolagDeMarker indicator, lacking independence and portability
No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially causing duplicate entries
No spread filter or trading session filter, may open positions under unfavorable conditions
DeMarker_period4 uses int type instead of uint, inconsistent with other period parameter types
No trailing stop mechanism; stop-loss and take-profit are fixed points, unable to adapt dynamically to market volatility
improvements: 添加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致仓位过重
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，提升交易质量
添加追踪止损功能，根据ATR或市场波动动态调整止损止盈水平
improvements_en: Add position existence check logic to avoid duplicate entries in the same direction that overweight the portfolio
Add spread filter and trading session filter to improve trade quality
Add trailing stop functionality to dynamically adjust stop-loss and take-profit levels based on ATR or market volatility

risk_points: 没有检查现有持仓，可能在同方向重复开仓导致过度敞口
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性变化，在高波动期可能频繁止损
依赖外部库和指标，如果缺失将导致初始化失败
risk_points_en: No existing position check may cause duplicate entries in the same direction, leading to excessive exposure
Fixed stop-loss/take-profit does not account for market volatility changes, may trigger frequent stop-outs during high volatility periods
Dependency on external library and indicator; missing components will cause initialization failure
